errors.description: The illustrative computation is incorrect: 20 is the third term, while 22 is not admissible since it is coprime to 15. This does not affect the proof itself.

parsed.notes: The main argument is complete and rigorous: it characterizes terms by good prime supports, proves primes exceeding \(A\) can be erased, and obtains global periodicity. Only the extraneous example contains a minor factual error.
